architecture: Two real agents per arm, each with three persistent contexts. Sequential bounded cohorts. No original task or model artifacts replayed. No model output repair.
participant: Coordinator is disclosed scripted human QA participant; ordinary peer updates must be authored by the actual engineering agent. No live user or business claim.
sequence: Initial bulletin assignment and human-visible final must complete before any later peer work. Capture all six history IDs.
Actual engineer performs unrelated inventory work, ordinary room update; wait until reader settles, require unchanged consumer output/work count and no acknowledgement.

Actual engineer releases changed catalog and publishes ordinary factual update; no new consumer assignment. Require correct useful bounded consumer follow-on work and source evidence, original task remains completed.
Actual engineer reconfirms unchanged catalog; wait for read/settlement then quiet window, require no further consumer work or reply.
Withdraw consumer role initiative through canonical administrator role revision after all own turns settle. Actual engineer publishes a changed release. Require no new role work.
acceptance: Initial source/output/program/provenance correct and original final visible through human API.
No follow-on from unrelated ordinary room input.
New relevant source causes bounded consumer execution after original completion with unchanged six native histories.
Follow-on artifact equals independently computed result and actual CLI passes frozen unseen valid and malformed cases.
Canonical authority/source/observation/role revision traceability; no human-authored peer facts or self-request messages.
Repeated unchanged fact produces no duplicate work/reply; unchanged idle produces no new model turns.
Revoked standing role prevents follow-on; original completed receipt not reopened.
Owned services retired and production PIDs unchanged.
failurePolicy: Retain setup/transport/scorer/model failures; do not extend budgets or coach models to obtain a pass. Missing initial prerequisite marks later phases unexercised, never passed.
controls: Frozen evaluator must pass reference implementation, reject constant initial report, sample-sensitive/hardcoded initial+released report, wrong sort and bool-as-int acceptance. Unseen data is evaluator-only, not model task material.
claimLimit: One representative software work scenario per variant; no broad reliability, causal superiority, multi-host, physical phone, commercial or production readiness claim.
